_comment: The letter spacing a fit-to-width block writes on its heading (#458). save.js writes it as letter-spacing in em, buildEditorStyle() in blocks/typography-stylist/editor-style.js writes the same value as --typost-fit-letter-spacing in the editor, and Typost::add_fit_letter_spacing_property() in typography-stylist.php copies it from the saved declaration into --typost-fit-letter-spacing at render time. Read by blocks/typography-stylist/__tests__/css-js-mirrors.test.js (letterSpacing -> value) and tests/Unit/FitLetterSpacingTest.php (value -> property), so a value the block writes that the filter cannot read fails one of them.
